title: →I (implication introduction)
text: If you can prove psi after adding phi as the last assumption, you can prove phi → psi without it.

title: Goal is an implication
text: When the goal is phi → psi, apply →I: assume phi at the end of the list and prove psi.

title: →I removes only the last assumption
text: If phi is in the list but not last, use Reorder to move it to the end first.
